text:
The University of Jordan is an established institution with two main campuses: the primary campus in Jubaiha, Amman, which spans 1,200 dunums, and the southern Aqaba Campus, which was established in 2009. The university traces its beginnings to the establishment of a national university, with King Hussein bin Talal inaugurating it on September 2, 1962.
Academically, the university is structured into scientific, humanitarian, and medical (health) faculties. Key academic units include the School of Science, the School of Engineering (the largest faculty), and the King Abdullah II School of Information Technology. The medical and health faculties consist of the School of Medicine (established in 1971), the School of Nursing, the School of Pharmacy, and the School of Dentistry. The University of Jordan Library (UJL), established in 1962, holds over one million items, and the institution hosts specialized centers such as the Jordan Academy of Arabic.
